scores.reasons: Gaps are stark (captcha-only intake, no click-to-call, no schema, template site) but this is a one-person licensed electrician with 13 reviews, so budget is the constraint; fixes are fast; all observed first-hand.

caveats: Ratings and review counts are point-in-time snapshots taken 2026-11-12. The logged-out Google Maps page in this session showed a limited view that usually omitted the review count, so counts are recorded only where Maps displayed them (ABAT 15, NJ Master Sewer 55, Almeida 13) or where the business itself displays them (Master Nick's 59; TEMPRO claims 300+).
Two listings sit on the North Brunswick / New Brunswick border: Kenneth & Sons' Google address is 66 Georges Rd, New Brunswick NJ 08901. North Brunswick town is kept as given in batch.json.

Scores are comparative within this batch, not absolute; a high gap_size with low ability_to_pay (Almeida) and a low gap_size with a modern site (Master Nick's) reflect very different sales approaches.
data_gaps: Alexander Plumbing: the site is behind a Cloudflare bot challenge; every page returned 'Just a moment... Performing security verification' in Chrome (never cleared over ~15s) and HTTP 403 to a plain client. No visual, form or schema inspection was possible, so website_review fields for that business are largely unverified.
Kenneth & Sons: kennethsonsplumbing.pro returned 403 Forbidden in Chrome on all three URLs tested, so the site was assessed from the HTML a plain HTTP client received rather than as a rendered page.
Kenneth & Sons: no staff count, years in business or service-area list could be confirmed anywhere.
AK Aire: the home page rendered blank for several seconds before painting; the exact load time was not measured precisely.

No Google review counts for Brunswick's Martial Arts Academy, Kenneth & Sons, Alexander Plumbing, TEMPRO, Remm Heating or AK Aire because the Maps view was limited; third-party aggregates (Birdeye/HomeAdvisor/Thumbtack) were not used to fill these in except where cited.
No contact forms were submitted anywhere; form fields were inspected only. No logins, purchases or outreach were performed.
